### About Me

Hi, I'm **Muhammad Ilham** — a developer focused on **backend development** and **home server maintenance**. I enjoy building reliable server-side applications, web services, and task automation tools using **Python** and **PHP**.

Alongside software development, I actively manage and maintain **Ubuntu-based home servers** — setting up self-hosted environments, optimizing system stability, and keeping services running smoothly day to day.
